name: Brazilian Government: Simulator
desc:
🇧🇷 Brazilian Government: Simulator 
Build your political career in a real-time Brazilian politics multiplayer.

🗳️ Gain support and fight elections against other players. 
🏛️ Become a Deputy, a Senator, or reach the Presidency of the Republic. 
📢 Debate, vote, and propose projects in the Congress. 
🤝 Join a party, form alliances, and negotiate political support. 
🇧🇷 As President, make decisions and govern the country. 
📈 Your decisions affect Health, Education, Security, Economy, and other areas. 
📰 Face crises, protests, and public opinion pressure. 

Each server writes a new political history.
Will you build a respected career, form a major political force, or rise to the most powerful position in the country?

Join the competition. The future of Brazil is in the hands of the players.
